profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Creating end to end automation testing script for React UI APP and API automation using Cypress with java Scripting. Proficient writing automation script Java Script, Cucumber for BDD testing and data driven testing.Software Quality Assurance Analyst with Proven Experience in AWS EMR.Testing AWS  S3 logic. Testing bigdata hdfs logs using piglatin and hive scripting, ETL process, testing of Client Server Applications, Front and Back End Testing with Unix and SQL,. Solid skills Though the Complete Q/A
 Life Cycle.
•	Excellent technical writing skills with hands on experience creating Business Requirements, Functional Specifications, Mapping Documents, Test Plans, Test Scripts.
•	Expertise in Process Management using JIRA to document Test Cases.
•	Experience working with huge volumes of data, analyzing record sets for Data Quality, Data Validation and Metrics using SQL and / or PL/SQL.
. Experience writing Cypress scripts for UI automation and API automation 
. Experience writing hadoop/bigdata test.
•	Proven ability to coordinate medium sized project from initial conceptualization through implementation.
•	Experience working with various software development methodologies including Agile, Iterative and Waterfall.
•	Excellent knowledge in Sybase, SQL server and Oracle Database Systems and Unix Platform.
•	Dynamic team player who is consistently motivated toward success and completion of projects with an ability to work independently.
•	A quick learner who can swiftly adapt to new challenges.

positions.title: QA Eng. / ETL/DW Tester/Data ingestion Test Engineer
positions.description:
Porject : Data Tech/ Data Ingestion

S&P Capital IQ is a leading provider of multi-asset class and real time market data, research and analytics. Getting real time electronic exchange and market data from FINRA and Quant House.

•	Responsible for extensive client interaction in order to estimate activities, design test plans/strategy and monitor the project QA deliverable  utilizing QA best practices.
•	Created test strategy and test plan documents ultimately verifying the traceability of test conditions to test cases.
•	Reconciled data loads from source files into staging table and staging table to target table by implementing tools such as SQL, Excel, and UNIX.
•	Defined entrance / exit criteria and provided continual risk assessments to senior management.
•	Defined ambiguities with the business and functional requirements in order to clarify with Business Analysts.
•	Provided test estimates for various phases of the project.
•	Verified traceability of Test Conditions to Test Cases.
•	Oversaw all phases of testing while coordinating with remote teams based in Denver and India.
•	Tested the Autosys job on UNIX server. 
•	Performed Web testing by using SoapUI 4.5.1.
•	Created automated script in JAVA for Web API.
•	Created automated test cases for regression phase by using SoapUI and Selenium. 
•	Examined sample record sets for consistency, data corruption and overall data quality.
•	Developed and executed functional/system test cases to ensure product meets functional and design specifications.
•	Reported product bugs and bug isolation so that proper procedures could be followed in order to rectify the bugs and issue appropriate resolutions.
•	Performed software quality management (SQM) process audits.
•	Executed the duties of a change release coordinator.
•	Created Change Release (CR) ticket based on CIP document (Change Implementation Plan).
positions.insights: Skills: Data Quality · Test Automation Framework · Agile Testing

positions.title: QA Software  Analyst/ETL Tester
positions.description:
MR Reporting  VAR retrival, which is built in Netezza platform from the current Sybase platform. MR warehouse is the single source of data repository for all “ML and BAC” Market Risk requirements. Data received from domain feeds gets loaded into MR Warehouse. Multiple downstream systems consume the data  for various business requirements like capturing P&L information, P & L Surveillance and are analyzed by Risk Managers across different dimensions.
Copying the market data into MR Warehouse and then generating reports from the warehouse that is used by Risk Managers to analyze high level statistical data on P & L information.

•Developed test cases and test scripts for data validation.
•Developed Tractability Matrix and Test Coverage reports.
•Managed and conducted System testing, Integration testing and Functional testing.
•Extensively used the AutoSys jobs for the entire project.
•Deployed Application tag and DB tag in server and extract the data file putting in appropriate folders by using UNIX various commands.
•Used Informatica as an ETL Tool for Developing the Data Warehouse.
•Worked on SQL scripts to load data in the tables.
•Loaded data to different databases using SQL scripts and maintained a repository for data loading scripts.
•Used Shell scripts extensively for automation of file manipulation and data loading procedures.
•Develop parameter driven ETL process to map source systems to target data warehouse with Informatica complete source system profiling.
•Execute batch processing and verify the jobs status and data in database tables.
•Tracked the defects using Clear Quest and Quality Center and generated defect summary reports.
•Interacted with developers, Business & Management Teams.
• Participated in regular project status meetings related to testing.
•Worked on Apache and Tomcat to migrate new web application in QA environment.

positions.title: QA Software Analyst
positions.description:
•Worked on Data Warehouse Testing. Involved in BO report requirement and performed business object report data validation by using SQL quires.  
•Performed migration testing on business object by comparing each report for different version of BO.
•Actively involved in ETL process testing.
The Standard & Poor is wall street base co. Responsible to  publishing credit ratings, providing investors and market participants worldwide with independent analysis of credit risk.  
Expertise in gathering System Requirements from Analyst, Understanding of Use Cases, business flow, technical Gaps.
Documented UAT Test Plan/Test cases using Testing Methodology .
Discussed Business Test Plan with internal Team, External Team. 
Interact with cross-functional team to install software, understand application functionalities, resolved daily defects, blocking defects, etc.
Reports test outcomes by collecting, analyzing, interpreting, summarizing, and displaying data.
Tested all UAT release, find defects, analyzed defects, discussed defects with assignees of defects, defect resolution, defect matrix and re-test and regression testing.
Frequent communication and collaboration with stakeholders . The ability to respond quickly to the demands of internal customers.
Assisted the Project Manager in developing the project schedule as it relates to Technical QA Analyst activities, dependencies and timelines to facilitate accurate project schedules. Follow the department software development life cycle (SDLC) and adhere to standards & best practices in the department.

	Developed SQL Script to validate Data Transaction in Front End Testing. Developed complicated and execute via Toad and saved Test Result.
	Using Unix Utilities like awk, grep, sed, vi, network, process, file level, directory level, etc with Shell Scripting and executed all test scenarios in minimal time.
	Worked on Web Server testing by using SOAPUI 4.0.1 and validate data in XML

positions.title: QA Software Analyst
positions.description: The Dow Jones is a Wall Street base co. Responsible to validate Real –Time XML transaction to make sure all data content is as per business requirement, identify all process validation using UNIX utilities to make sure  real time story and headline for the Doe Jones Co.Responsible for testing of different transaction including data validation, business constraint. Project ACC demands that the information coming in realtime is tested and configured to match their clients system needs.Testing consists of running manual test cases on LINUX servers via shell scripts and command-line programs, and analyzing results by looking through log files, spreadsheets, and a Windows Client front end.Interact with SDLC team to update each release QA Test Plan to cover all business scenarios using Testing Methodology.creates and modifies test scripts (SQL) to validate system changes.Installed all new release in the multi Linux Server using network commands and protocols.

positions.title: Senior QA Software Analyst
positions.description: Involved in testing of application for customer support application. Application has GUI interaction Application Server (WAS 7.0) with Database Application in Oracle 11g on UNIX Server (HP UNIX) via Real Time XML Transaction in http request/response. 	Designed and developed QA Test Plan/Test Cases.Provided Test metrics .Developed SQL Script (Developed complicated SQL Script in Toad) to validate data, automated UNIX based process (Using Unix Utilities like awk, grep, sed, vi, network, process, file level, directory level, etc) with Shell Scripting and executed all test scenarios in minimal time.	Involved in key learning process after each release to implement process in future as a part of QA process Management.Interacted with team to resolve daily issues in installation, code delivery, documentation, and defects.	Supported Change Control by reviewing impact of all modules planned all release schedules, back out plan.Supported production support team in production issue to analyze root cause of problems and resolved with team.	Involved in different major and minor release testing by updating test plan with testing methodology, reviewed test results and analyzed defects and resolved with team.

positions.title: QA Software Analyst
positions.description: Involved in testing of extraction process from database using back end process and dump into data file of specific delimiter. Involved in different release to validate testing using UNIX utilities and SQL. Involved in multiple extract processes like billing Extract Error detection report, External Party Management Report. Support Ad-hoc project including production support enhancement and delta changes to current product.Interact with Business Analyst to understand Application Requirement and gathered Major/Minor functionality of requirements.Communicated with Project Management to establish LOE of each phase of SDLC and prioritized QA task.	Developed SQL Script to validate Data Transaction in Front End Testing. Developed complicated and execute via Toad and saved Test Result.Performed functional testing by deployment request, sanity testing, prioritized QA Test Cases within project plan.Performed Defect Root Cause Analysis, interacted with related Team, and tracked defects in a Test Director.	Involved in Back End Testing using UNIX Utilities and automated Regression Testing using Korn shell scripting.	Assisted business & marketing team in execution of UAT by providing data.Involved in System Integration Testing with external/Internal interface and understood overall customer business functionalities.

positions.title: QA Software Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for Testing of NJM Claim information System to keep track of all Claim information related to accident including billing and payment methods. Application has complicated GUI with Oracle/UNIX to maintain all back end transaction.
Environment: UNIX (HP/SUN/AIX), Oracle, JAVA, Shell Script, Websphere Tool
	Interacted with business analyst team to understand business requirement, customer expectation and experience and performed GAP Analysis. 	Updated, maintained, and promoted Test Plans and Scripts to Configuration Management for version control.	Recorded and tracked defects uncovered during the execution of tests scripts.	Provided timely and accurate status defect information and appropriate metrics to facilitate QA reporting. Reported individual status: dashboard information, open issues, risk analysis. Used Quality Center to tack for defect cycle. Monitored the defect tracking process and generated customized reports using Test Director.Used SQL Queries – Complicated SQL to validate Data constraints for both Front End and Back End Testing.	Performed back end testing like data file validation testing using UNIX Commands. (grep, awk, sed, etc)	Participated in test planning, test case design and test script walkthroughs with QA Leads. Understood testing to be accomplished and suggested changes for efficiencies within or between projects.	Involved in QA, SIT, UAT testing to complete release testing, sign off all interface testing and review QA Results with team.	Developed and sustained appropriate relationship with peers and other project team members.
